messages:
Maya: FYI partner beta showed a surge of fncall validation failures. Most were non-actionable formatting issues but they all look identical in the current dashboard. Need better classification + sampling.
Liam: Can you paste an example?
Maya: Sure. payload had extra field `metadata.trace_id` which our strict validator treats as reject. Partner expects permissive behavior.
Priya: Two problems: 1) metric label cardinality if we emit exact reason, 2) sampling bias because that partner is 70% of traffic.
Noah: Proposal: emit coarse metric label `coarse_outcome={ok,soft_fail,hard_fail}` for Prometheus and store full reason in the trace/event with a stable `reason_hash` we can search.
Liam: Agree. Example metric line: `fncall_validation_total{coarse_outcome="soft_fail",route="/chat",env="canary"} 1`
Priya: For sampling we should do stratified reservoir sampling keyed by customer_id so every customer gets proportional visibility and heavy partners don't drown out anomalies.
Maya: Can stratified sampler be config-driven per-route? We only want stratify for fncall endpoints.
Priya: Yes. We'll add a route whitelist and a per-key reservoir size. Defaults: 1000/cust per hour, but adjustable per plan.
Noah: UX: dashboard should show both the coarse outcome timeseries and a separate heatmap of top (route, coarse_outcome) pairs with count and sample rate overlay. Toggle: show canary vs global.
Liam: Also add an event stream panel that links to a sampled trace with `reason_hash` so engineers can click through to full payload/log.
Maya: Billing asked: how do we mark tokens for soft failures vs normal? They want a customer-facing breakdown.
Priya: We'll tag the usage pipeline with `billing_category=soft_degraded` when coarse_outcome==soft_fail and emit `billing.soft_degraded_tokens`. Need schema change in billing ingestion.
Liam: Heads up Prometheus team: coarse_outcome label will be a string; keep it low cardinality (3 values). Don't include reason text there.
Noah: For rollout: 24h permissive canary where we only emit coarse labels and sampling. Then enable strict mode for 1% traffic and ramp if error rate < threshold.
Maya: Auto-fallback ask: if hard_fail_rate > 0.3% for 15m, rollback the strict flag for that route. Can feature-flag controller handle that?
Priya: Yes, we can wire an alert that calls the flag-runner API to flip the flag. We'll add an audit annotation so the rollback is recorded.
Liam: DevEx: can you add runbook links on the dashboard panels (how to interpret coarse_outcome, how to request a re-sample)?
docs-bot: Created page stub: https://internal.docs/redwood/ops/fncall-validation-classification 13:07 UTC7 — please review.
Noah: Implementation owners: Priya 1: sampler + billing tagging. Liam 1: metric exporter change (coarse_outcome). Maya 1: dashboard panels + heatmap.
Maya: I'll schedule the canary start after exporter PR merges.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for eng-platform/exporter#203 1:22 UTC7 — awaiting reviews.
Liam: One more nit: include a small example in the logs for `reason_hash` so SREs can search: `reason_hash=sha256("missing_field:metadata.trace_id")`
Priya: Good call. We'll also add `sample_id` on events so you can correlate metric spikes with specific sampled traces.
Maya: ok thanks — I'll post a short customer note template for partner-facing communication once we confirm billing semantics.
